about.howMade: This guide was written by an AI agent on 19 November 2026, the day the game released, from research of the published trophy lists and the guides linked on this page. Every guide paragraph is written in its own words for this entry; the official trophy names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Nothing here was copied from another guide — each trophy names its sources beside it, and where no published guide confirms a step, the guide says so instead of inventing one.
about.offline: This app works fully offline: it loads only its own files, makes no network request, and saves your progress in your browser's localStorage. Source links open only when you click them.
about.release: Grand Theft Auto VI released on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
about.unofficial: This is an unofficial fan-made guide. It is not published by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Rockstar Games, and it uses no Rockstar logo, artwork, box art or game screenshot. Grand Theft Auto and GTA are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive.
about.warning: Warning: no trophy information in this guide is verifiable from the game itself yet, because the game has only just released, and Rockstar has published no official trophy list. The names, descriptions and grades come from the trophy trackers Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree with each other on all 55, and the steps come from the guides cited per trophy. Four trophies have no confirmed method in any published guide as of 19 November 2026, and those guides say so openly. Treat every step as the best published information on launch day, not as confirmed fact.

flagged.name: Positive Mental Attitude
flagged.when: Chapter 1, after the main mission Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept.
flagged.why: The first meditation, on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. PowerPyx is still unsure whether it is required for the trophy, since it is not marked as a meditation spot like the other 18 — do it in Chapter 1 anyway.

notMissable: All 12 story trophies (chapters and named missions) — main missions stay available until played.
All 5 character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) — PowerPyx confirms every trophy-related quest giver is available again after the story.
All 8 stranger strands, all robberies, all collectibles and all activities — doable in free-roam after the story.
The 100% checklist — nothing on it is missable.
missables.saveAdvice: Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter (15 manual slots). There is no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back if you skip the Chapter 1 meditation.
missables.summary: Built only from the official descriptions and what the cited guides confirm. PowerPyx flags exactly one trophy as potentially missable; everything else is confirmed still available after the story in free-roam.
missables.title: Missable trophies

roadmap.intro: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours to the platinum, in a single playthrough, with no online trophies and no difficulty settings. The story takes roughly 60–80 hours; the rest is the 100% checklist and cleanup. These three steps follow the order PowerPyx lays out, built from the official trophy descriptions.

steps.name: Finish the story — and watch Chapter 1
notes: The one thing to watch: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia offers to show you how to meditate on the balcony at Jason's house. Do it — it becomes unavailable after Chapter 1 and may be required for Positive Mental Attitude.
Start the side strands as they are marked: Kenton in Chapter 1, Billy after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, Andy, Randy and Tyrone in Chapter 3.
Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter. There is no mission replay, and the game has 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave slot.
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go — the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base vehicles and 100 of 255 animals.
steps.summary: Play the story through Chapters 1–5 and finish the final mission. The 100% checklist is not visible until after the story, but progress made during the story already counts toward it, so do side content as you find it.
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.name: The 100% Completion Checklist
notes: Tasks that need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
You only need 70 of the 80 challenges, 100 of 100+ optional missions (there are far more than 100), 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations and 300 of 397 stunts.
Most side quests are not required for 100% at all, and many collectible types are only partly required.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything is doable in free-roam after the story.
steps.summary: After the story, the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It is lenient — roughly 60% true completion — but it is the biggest single block of work, and it carries the gold trophy A Long Road.

steps.name: Strangers & Freaks and the last stragglers
notes: Strangers & Freaks strands are not needed for 100%, so they are often the last big block.

Check the four trophies no published guide has confirmed yet (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) against the sources in each guide — the methods may be known by the time you get here.
When the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! — the platinum — pops with it.
steps.summary: Most trophies are already done by now. Finish the stranger strands, the remaining character questlines, and any one-off stunt trophies left over.

roadmap.title: Road to the Platinum — 3 steps

strategies.text: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate with her. It is the only thing in the game that can become permanently unavailable, and it may gate Positive Mental Attitude.
strategies.title: Do the Chapter 1 meditation

strategies.text: There is no mission replay. Fifteen manual save slots are plenty: one at the start and end of each chapter, the rest rotating through free-roam cleanup.
strategies.title: Keep a save at the start of every chapter

strategies.text: WAiNK-scan every new vehicle (hold up, then R1) and study every new animal through binoculars (hold L1, zoom with up, hold R1). The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and starting early means it happens naturally.
strategies.title: Scan everything, study everything

strategies.text: Optional missions are purple icons and black icons with pink letters; main missions are pink with black letters. You need any 100 optional missions for 100%, and there are easily 200–300 in total, so doing them as they appear keeps you ahead.
strategies.title: Do optional missions as they appear

strategies.text: Most trophies fall out of the checklist. Chase the checklist tasks and the trophies follow; chasing trophies one by one wastes trips across the map.
strategies.title: Work on the 100% checklist, not the trophy list

strategies.text: Hot Together, Retail Therapy, bank vaults and maxing strength all need your partner beside you. After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call them with hold-right plus triangle and keep them with you for robberies and workouts.
strategies.title: Use the partner for everything paired

strategies.text: Bank vaults (Chapter 4) pay up to $205,000 each and feed Dime on the Dollar, Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together at once. Shops and jewelry stores are available from Chapter 3 and feed Retail Therapy and Sneakthief.
strategies.title: Rob banks late, rob shops early

strategies.text: Each garage adds parking spots for the Scooter Bros app. Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) through the Vice City Real Estate app, then register cheap cars and bikes with Moses to keep costs down.
strategies.title: Buy garages before registering cars

strategies.text: Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. By late game you will be near max, which makes Gunslinger's 5-kills-in-one-Combat-Focus much easier.
strategies.title: Level Focus through play, not grinding

strategies.text: You need 50 of 80 challenges for One Last Thing and 70 of 80 for 100%. There are 10 more than needed, so skip anything that frustrates you and come back only if you must.
strategies.title: Pick the easy challenges, skip the hard ones

strategies.text: The Goodtime State needs the whole map unfogged. Wait until you have a plane and the full map open, then fly over every fogged patch in one run instead of driving into each one.
strategies.title: Unfog the map by plane in one sweep

strategies.text: Cheats disable trophies and saving. Cheats only unlock after the story anyway, so there is no reason to use one before the platinum pops.
strategies.title: Never touch a cheat during a trophy run

tips.text: Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations; Progress, then Gangs; Progress, then Challenges. The game tracks almost everything — use it instead of guessing.
tips.title: Check the in-game trackers

tips.text: Each meditation spot counts twice if both Jason and Lucia meditate there, and the final spot needs both characters together.
tips.title: Meditate with both characters

tips.text: For a 4-star escape, drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
tips.title: The train tunnel escape

tips.text: Consume Adrenaline (hold L1, press triangle) before triggering Combat Focus to lengthen the slow-time window for Gunslinger.
tips.title: Adrenaline stretches Combat Focus

tips.text: Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile: a demon face appears whenever an action counts toward the 500 for Actions Speak Louder.
tips.title: Turn on criminal profile notifications

tips.text: A clean delivery pays more, and the money helps toward the $160,000 for all 8 garages.
tips.title: Deliver Randy's cars in good condition

tips.text: Capital Offense needs the specific blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom, after the Key Cloner — no other car through the window counts.
tips.title: The blue Banshee only

tips.text: You cannot carry all the cash alone. Bring your partner and hand off a bag with hold-right, or the vault robbery stalls.
tips.title: Bank vaults need your partner
